source: Exact algorithm means no deliberate mathematical approximation of dense attention. Bitwise identical implementation means every finite-precision operation lands on exactly the same bits. ZXNAME0000XZ promises the first idea, not the second across arbitrary kernels.
zh: 精确的算法意味着没有刻意的密集注意力的数学近似。按位相同的实现意味着每个有限精度运算都位于完全相同的位上。 ZXNAME0000XZ 承诺第一个想法，而不是跨任意内核的第二个想法。
